yearGuidance.year1: Spring-week applications run from about June to April: banks mostly October-November, trading and consulting January-February. Many review on a rolling basis, so apply in the first fortnight a programme opens, and use a tracker to spot openings (its dates are estimates). Join the investment society and start a stock pitch or weekly markets note. Considering actuarial or insurance work? That is a different route (IFoA exams, actuarial placements): see Prospects 'Actuary'.
yearGuidance.2nd: Your stage depends on your course. Three-year degree: you're penultimate (see that advice: summer internships, rolling deadlines). Four-year course: spring weeks for students graduating in two years' time are often still open to you. Placement-year degree: apply in the autumn of your second year for 12-month industrial placements.
yearGuidance.penultimate: Banks open summer internships from about June to September and most review on a rolling basis (Goldman Sachs says so), so apply as early in the window as you can and expect places to fill. Go in with one finished model or pitch, a committee role, and practice for online tests and video interviews. On a placement-year degree, apply for 12-month placements in the same autumn.
yearGuidance.final: No internship yet? Apply to programmes that admit final-year students (GS Summer Analyst eligibility includes final year), to off-cycle internships (Lent term is key for them), to boutique and mid-market firms (they hire less formally, year-round) and to graduate schemes at retail and corporate banks. Lead with quantified experience of any kind.
yearGuidance.postgrad: Master's students can apply to the GS Summer Analyst Programme if they are in the penultimate or final year of study. Check each firm's eligibility page.
yearGuidance.note: For 4-year courses, shift each line by one year (spring weeks are for the second year of a four-year degree).

actions.description: A week-long London programme (5-10 April 2027) in software engineering, trading and research, or strategy and product, for women, transgender and/or gender-expansive students. Travel, meals and housing are covered and no finance knowledge is needed. Check eligibility yourself; we never ask for or store your background.
